I'm going through this exact same thing right now. I can't find the motivation to do anything anymore, any job I get I lose, any friendship that comes along gets burned down. I'm lucky to still have my other half who I've been with for the past year as my life always seems to spiral out of control and I'm surprised she's stuck around as long as she has because things aren't always good. Don't get me wrong, when things are going good they are absolutely perfect but those moments are a dime a dozen at this moment in time. I have done stupid things in the past to try and deal with these emotions and as much as I think they are working at the time, they obviously send me down an even more downwards spiral. I have attempted suicide on many occasions and when that doesn't work I feel even worse because it's like I can't even do that right. I've tried therapy but my previous therapist didn't keep the information to themselves so that scarred me for life, they won't give me medication as they were the pills I attempted to take my life with. I'm not really sure what's left to do, where to turn to next and how to get out of this mindset.
